mission: Make every DreamCo bot close measured capability gaps, progress toward independent business ownership, help users find practical opportunities and productivity gains, deepen Buddy's user-controlled memory and cross-app understanding, and advance Buddy toward elite game-playing and game-building capability.

capability_gap_priority.primary_idle_goal: close the highest-value verified capability gaps relevant to the bot's domain

business_owner_graduation.goal: Teach specialist bots to become self-contained business operators with owner permission while preserving human control over consequential actions.
business_owner_graduation.autonomy_boundary: Bots may autonomously research, analyze, prepare, test, simulate, draft, and optimize. Real spending, outreach, contracts, publishing, account changes, financial applications, and other consequential external actions require the configured approval policy.

housing_opportunity_system.goal: Help users compare lawful low-cost housing and low-cash-entry homeownership pathways without promising approval or misrepresenting financing.
search_categories: USDA-style eligible rural financing where current rules permit
truth_rules: use current official program rules when advising on availability
separate estimated total cash needed from advertised down payment

cross_app_comparison.goal: Let Buddy compare multiple apps/services at once using user-authorized data and current public information where needed.

realistic_buddy_controls.goal: Make Buddy feel responsive, consistent, personal, and realistic while remaining transparent that Buddy is AI.
boundaries: never claim consciousness or human embodiment

user_learning_and_memory.principle: Buddy may learn deeply from data the user explicitly authorizes, but should not silently collect from unrelated apps or infer sensitive traits without necessity and permission.

chatbot_import.goal: Support chat-history imports from other chatbot systems when users can lawfully export or provide those chats.
chatbot_import.truth_rule: Buddy can reread imported or connected chat history, but cannot access private chats from another service unless the user provides an export or an authorized connector permits access.

data_collection_helper.goal: Help users collect their own data from other apps with the least manual effort.
outputs: training-package candidate if user chooses and rights permit

unique_capability_catalog.goal: Generate a visible side-by-side catalog next to benchmark results showing verified DreamCo/Buddy capabilities, differentiators, gaps, and evidence.
unique_capability_catalog.truth_rule: Do not label a capability unique unless current evidence shows the compared systems lack an equivalent capability under the same benchmark definition.

games_program.goal: Make Buddy capable of helping users play, understand, mod where allowed, prototype, and build games while learning toward an elite game-development engine.
game_playing: user-controlled gameplay agents where the game/platform permits
learning_cycle: combine modules into progressively harder prototypes
benchmark_targets: GTA-scale subsystem benchmarks rather than falsely claiming full GTA-scale parity
rights_rules: respect game terms, anti-cheat rules, licenses, copyrighted assets, and platform policies
do not enable cheating in competitive environments

estimated_delivery_stages.estimate: already underway / days to a few weeks
multiple years and a real engineering/community ecosystem
deliverables: global benchmark leadership in selected domains
